turns.assessment: The evidence localizes a roughly 5.6 dB all-channel loss ahead of the first amplifier on S13→S01: amp0 input and all subsequent amplifier powers fell by nearly the same amount, while pump currents did not change. Multiple OCM channels at S01 also fell, and downstream amplification restored power but not OSNR, producing the OSNR/BER degradation at S15. A dirty OMS-input connector at S13 is the documented soft fault matching this pattern, and recent S13 maintenance further supports it; a pulled connector, pump failure, or fibre cut would instead cause signal loss.

proposals.rationale: Contamination on the S13 ROADM-to-booster patch for S13→S01 explains the equal approximately 5.6 dB reduction at the booster input, every amplifier output, and multiple downstream channels. Stable pump currents exclude amplifier pump ageing/failure, while residual signal excludes a pulled connector or fibre cut. The resulting low OSNR explains the coherent receiver degradation affecting svc275.
